name: UNSW Sydney
description: UNSW Sydney is a public research university founded in 1949 in Sydney, New South Wales. It is a member of the Group of Eight and is known for engineering, business and law.
whyIncluded: A Group of Eight university on both the Singapore Medical Council and the Singapore Institute of Legal Education (SILE) recognition lists, with a Singapore Students' Association on campus.

livingCosts.notes: UNSW 'Weekly living expenses in Sydney for international students' table (figures accurate as of May 2025), 'Share house' column, weekly x 52/12, range midpoints. Housing: accommodation $290 + utilities and internet $65/wk. Food: $120-$250/wk. Transport: public transport $55/wk. Personal: phone plan $10-$20 + lifestyle spending $50-$100/wk. UNSW's share-house total is $590-$780/wk ($30,680-$40,560 over 52 weeks); other columns: on-campus apartment $555-$960, college $505-$760 (44 weeks), one-bedroom unit $785-$1,335/wk.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Engineering (Honours)
programmes.notes: 2026 indicative first-year international fee (48 UOC). Compulsory = 2026 SSAF A$124/term x 3 terms. 2024/2025 = international undergraduate Engineering per-UOC rate x 48 UOC (UNSW fee archive). Fees reviewed annually.

programmes.name: Master of Information Technology
programmes.notes: 2026 indicative first-year international fee; 96 UOC. Compulsory = 2026 SSAF A$124/term x 3 terms. 2024/2025 = international postgraduate COMP per-UOC rate x 48 UOC (UNSW fee archive). Fees reviewed annually.

programmes.name: Master of Commerce
programmes.notes: 2026 indicative first-year international fee (total to complete A$96,000). 72 UOC = 1.5 full-time years; UNSW lists 1.7 calendar years. Compulsory = 2026 SSAF A$124/term x 3 terms. 2024/2025 = international postgraduate Business School per-UOC rate x 48 UOC (UNSW fee archive).

programmes.name: Bachelor of Laws (combined degree, e.g. Bachelor of Arts / Bachelor of Laws)
programmes.notes: UNSW offers the LLB only as a double degree (Arts/Law 4782 is 240 UOC over 5 years, CRICOS 005947G). Figure = 2026 international undergraduate LAWS per-UOC rate A$1,185 x 48 UOC (1.0 EFTSL), i.e. the law fee band; UNSW's own 2026 indicative first-year fee for Arts/Law is A$52,500 because year 1 is mostly Arts courses. Compulsory = 2026 SSAF A$124/term x 3 terms. 2024/2025 = international undergraduate LAWS per-UOC rate x 48 UOC (UNSW fee archive). Fees reviewed annually.

programmes.name: Juris Doctor
programmes.notes: 2026 indicative first-year international fee (program 9150, CRICOS 068850G; total to complete A$193,500); 3 years full time. Compulsory = 2026 SSAF A$124/term x 3 terms. 2024/2025 = international postgraduate JURD per-UOC rate x 48 UOC (UNSW fee archive). Fees reviewed annually.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Medical Studies / Doctor of Medicine
programmes.notes: 2026 indicative first-year international fee (program 3805, CRICOS 077423G; undergraduate entry, 6 years; total to complete A$647,000, so later years cost more). Compulsory = 2026 SSAF A$124/term x 3 terms. 2024/2025 = international undergraduate MFAC (Medicine) per-UOC rate x 48 UOC (UNSW fee archive). Fees reviewed annually.
